events.title: The demo is now available!
events.summary: I'm happy to announce that the demo of my puzzle game is finally available for download and play! In the demo version you'll find:12 handcrafted puzzle levels4 different types of levels with unique game mechanics10–30 minutes of gameplayAnd, of course, plenty of portals :)Play the demo and add the full game to your wishlist!

events.title: New game mechanics
events.summary: Hello, puzzle lovers! I’ve finished working on the 4th game mechanic. It’s a Sokoban style game featuring lasers and, of course, portals.This mechanic is a bit more complex and differs from the previous ones. Now, we have to take the portals' rotation into account, as the laser maintains its direction relative to the entry and exit portals. events.title: First introduction
events.summary: Hello everyone! My name is Dmitry Galias, I am a solo game developer. And this is my game "Portal way". In this first post, I’d like to briefly talk about my game and some plans for the future. I personally love puzzles, and you can probably guess which other puzzle game inspired mine just by the game title.
